_note: The ricochet's glance (Game Design's fight-feel.md section 3; rulings-2026-10-22.md 2b; sim/core/ricochet.gd; docs/architecture/ricochet-core.md). Speeds are normalised: a launch's traversal factor divided out, as World's contact reads them.
_enabled: the one switch. SimCore.newMatch copies it into S.ricOn unless the match's setup has its own "ricochet". Off: no glance, no ricochet state hashed, no ricochet event, and this file is not read into a replay
_line: units a second into the surface (the speed along its normal): at or above it a glancing contact glances; below it is Combat's plant (Encounter's)
_maxAngle: degrees to the surface: under it, a glance; at or above it, the wall slam, the lodge or the chain as before
_keep: the share of his speed a glance keeps (angle in equal to angle out)
_maxInRow: the most ricochets in a row for one send, glances and plants together: then the next surface is a plain contact
